pairing: New three-file projects with equivalent buggy behavior. Four deliberately ambiguous public suites, three single-candidate controls, one control requiring two edits. Count every family and abstention. Fixtures are fixed before timing.
search: First failing public example determines the entered definitions. Same integer arithmetic/comparison operators and two product-plus-addend rewrites. At most 32 single changes. Stop checking a candidate at its first failing public example. Verify equal witness, edit counts, and green-set cardinality in both arms.
probes: Generate the same boundary grid in TIDE during each timed run, excluding old public inputs. Stop at the first valid disagreement among all green candidates, up to 32 inputs and 128 candidate evaluations. Verify the same probe sequence length, selected input, and output multiset.
resolution: Confirm the sole proposed input with the separate TIDE contract function. Add the confirmed public case, repeat the same filter, and validate and apply only a singleton. No model fallback. Run all public and 72 held-out cases only after patch application. If no singleton survives, record an abstention.
timer: Local monotonic wall clock from immediately before generating the probe pool to acceptance or abstention. Includes process starts, initial failing test with public filter and probe search, expected-value confirmation, adding the case, rerunning the public filter, actual source edit with public recheck, and independent final acceptance. Fixture staging and tool builds are outside the timer.
repetitions: One unrecorded dry pair, then 12 timed pairs per task in alternating TIDE/Python-AST order. Rotate task order each round. Sequential runs on one pinned logical CPU with OS caches warm, fresh directories and fresh processes at every stage.
accounting: Report successes over all attempts, medians and nearest-rank P95 for elapsed time, separately for successes and abstentions, paired differences overall and by family, and actual tokens in and out of all model requests. No model is started.
